## A quiet Double 11 in Southeast Asia


When Double 11 was introduced in 2009, it gave Asia a shopping event to rival Black Friday, recording massive sales numbers every year. Today, with promotions running throughout the year and increased competition from social commerce, how much does the 11 November still stand out for the e-commerce platforms?


At[Measurable AI](https://measurable.ai/) , we build and own a unique consumer panel and are the largest transactional email receipt data provider for the emerging markets. According to our Southeast Asia e-receipt panel, this year, Shopee was the only one of the three platforms we tracked to record more orders around Double 11 than a year earlier. Yet on 11 November itself, both Shopee and SHEIN recorded roughly twice as many orders as on an average October day in Measurable AI’s Southeast Asia e-receipt panel.


**Key findings:** In Measurable AI’s Southeast Asia e-receipt panel, Shopee was the only one of three platforms to record more Double 11 orders than a year earlier, up 9% for 10–12 November 2026 vs 2025. Temu orders fell about 13% and SHEIN orders fell 21%. Average order value moved the other way: it rose 7% on SHEIN and 1% on Temu, and fell 10% on Shopee.


## Shopee orders rose 9% as Temu and SHEIN orders fell


We compared orders from 10 to 12 November 2026 with the same three days in 2025, capturing the day before, the day of and the day after Double 11. Over that window, Shopee orders rose 9% year over year, while[Temu](https://blog.measurable.ai/2024/09/20/the-psychology-of-discounts-temu-vs-shein-vs-shopee-vs-lazada-tiktok-shop/) orders fell around 13% and SHEIN orders fell 21%. That puts the gap between Shopee’s and SHEIN’s order growth at 30 percentage points. Our analysis pools available receipts for the three platforms across Singapore, Indonesia, Malaysia, the Philippines, Thailand and Vietnam.


Measurable AI: Estimates of the year-on-year change in Double 11 orders for Shopee, Temu and SHEIN are based on orders captured by Measurable AI’s Southeast Asia e-receipt panel, pooled across Singapore, Indonesia, Malaysia, the Philippines, Thailand and Vietnam, comparing 10–12 November 2026 with the same window in 2025.


## How did 11 November compare with an average October day?


Double 11 still stood out on all three platforms. On 11 November 2026, order volume was 32% above October’s daily average on Temu, 93% above it on SHEIN and 99% above it on Shopee. We measured each platform against its own average daily order count in October of the same year.


SHEIN saw the sharpest change by this measure. Its 11 November lift grew from 71% above its October average in 2025 to 93% above it in 2026. So even as SHEIN recorded fewer orders across the three-day window than a year earlier, the festival day itself stood out more against October.


Temu’s lift held nearly steady, moving from 31% to 32%. Shopee’s eased from 123% to 99%, though it still recorded roughly twice its October daily average on 11 November 2026.


## Average order value fell on Shopee and rose on SHEIN


Shopee recorded more orders over the three-day window, but shoppers spent less per order on average than they did a year earlier. SHEIN showed the reverse pattern. Its order count fell, while its average order value (AOV) rose. Average order value in USD rose 7% year on year on SHEIN and 1% on Temu over Double 11, and fell 10% on Shopee.


Measurable AI: Estimates of the year-on-year change in Double 11 average order value in USD for Shopee, Temu and SHEIN are based on orders captured by Measurable AI’s Southeast Asia e-receipt panel, pooled across Singapore, Indonesia, Malaysia, the Philippines, Thailand and Vietnam, comparing 10–12 November 2026 with the same window in 2025.


Was Shopee’s order growth concentrated in one market or spread across Southeast Asia? This Double 11, the average order value fell on Shopee and rose on SHEIN. Agentic commerce raises a new question for the next shopping festival: how does the basket change when an AI shopping agent helps a customer decide what to buy?
